scope: Only the explicitly listed closed sessions, not automatically the whole study. Unknown/missing document views and rejected edits remain visible. Canonical JSON and standard Python AST facts are not global semantics, native effects, measured gain, plan fulfillment or a causal feedback result. This analysis never supplies a diagnostic to an author, changes a candidate or loss, runs code or reselects.

diagnostic.scope: Canonical JSON/standard direct Python AST facts only. JSON object-member order is not assessed; list order and literal source text are retained. AST equality is not whole-program/world equivalence; AST difference is not operative behavior or benefit. Nested/non-Python/new runtimes remain unassessed by the AST diagnostic, not forbidden. List order/multiplicity, unavailable/ambiguous nodes and invalid source are retained. No candidate is changed, repaired, rejected, promoted or required to differ. No plan prose is interpreted or implemented. This report has no measured native loss.
